title: The limits of a prediction
paragraphs: A research team developed a model to predict demand for public transport.
Its accuracy was impressive during ordinary weeks.
Unexpected disruptions, nevertheless, exposed weaknesses that average performance had concealed.
The researchers therefore argued for evaluating predictions under exceptional conditions as well as routine ones.

options.text: Reliable evaluation must include unusual situations.
options.explanation: Olağandışı koşullar da değerlendirmeye dahil edilmeli.

options.text: Accuracy is always a misleading concept.
options.explanation: Doğruluğun her zaman yanıltıcı olduğu söylenmiyor.

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about average performance?

options.text: It was lower than every individual prediction.
It can hide failures in particular circumstances.
options.explanation: Ortalama başarı özel koşullardaki zayıflıkları gizleyebiliyor.

questions.prompt: Why are ordinary weeks contrasted with disruptions?

options.text: To establish that disruptions never occur
To show that the team changed the data
To demonstrate the need for broader evaluation
options.explanation: Farklı koşulların değerlendirme kapsamına alınması gerektiğini gösteriyor.
